Hanno Station Tourist Information Center "Puratto Hanno" will close temporarily on June 3, 2025 (Wednesday) due to Typhoon No. 6 approaching the area. Normal hours will resume on June 4 (Thursday). Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association (located inside Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry) will remain open as usual on June 3.

For more information: https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e9%a3%af%e8%83%bd%e9%a7%85%e8%a6%b3%e5%85%89%e6%a1%88%e5%86%85%e6%89%80%e3%80%8c%e3%81%b7%e3%82%89%e3%81%a3%e3%81%a8%e9%a3%af%e8%83%bd%e3%80%8d6%e6%9c%883%e6%97%a5%e6%b0%b4%e5%8f%b0%e9%a2%a8
